description:
## [0.0.5](https://github.com/RabehX/rabehx-patches/compare/v0.0.4...v0.0.5) (2026-11-23)

### Bug Fixes

* **baridimob:** migrate to Morphe 2.5 binary XML API and fix lazy TLS config lookup ([6ae688a](https://github.com/RabehX/rabehx-patches/commit/6ae688ac713449acbf69493437fc94fc0d039965))

### Features

* **myooredoo:** support 1.5.21 with tracking removal, root bypass and spoof signature ([3efe481](https://github.com/RabehX/rabehx-patches/commit/3efe481375694e398067a18da44d4dad9e61bb81))
* **webetu:** support 2.5.0 with Hermes freeze/watermark patches and telemetry removal ([a9f26ac](https://github.com/RabehX/rabehx-patches/commit/a9f26ac06971ab3970d1e0ac1da33f518fd84854))

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes the FLAG_SECURE screen capture block and disables Android 14+ screenshot detection callbacks so screenshots and recordings work everywhere.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and OTA updates
patches.description: Disables Expo OTA updates so patched JS bundles are not overwritten, removes Sentry crash/performance telemetry and root checks, and strips leaked debug tooling while keeping Firebase push notifications working.

patches.name: Fix screen freeze
patches.description: Fixes dashboard buttons becoming disabled after resuming from the background.

patches.name: Remove PairIP protection
patches.description: Removes Google Play's PairIP anti-tamper wrapper, restores the original Application class, strips com.pairip.* components and CHECK_LICENSE, and neuters the license client.

patches.name: Remove screen watermark
patches.description: Removes the diagonal student registration number watermark overlaid on screens.

patches.name: Disable Frida Detection
patches.description: Improves compatibility with debugging tools. Covers the Dart maps scan, the VdoCipher native marker and the rjsniffer port scanner.

patches.name: Disable Play Integrity
patches.description: Short-circuits Google Play Integrity with "DISABLED", retains original APK v1/v2 signatures, and spoofs app integrity checksum/signature checks.

patches.name: Disable SSL Pinning
patches.description: Makes the Dart SPKI validator return its own success value, so the app's public key pinning no longer rejects intercepted TLS connections. Covers arm64-v8a and x86_64; armeabi-v7a keeps pinning.

patches.name: Disable developer options detection
patches.description: Stops the app from detecting Developer Options, USB debugging or debuggable flags, removing the blocking security dialog.

patches.name: Disable root & emulator detection
patches.description: Forces every root, jailbreak, emulator, hook and mock-location check to report a clean device across Java/Kotlin, Dart AOT, RootBeer, SafeDevice, VdoCipher and rjsniffer native probes, and removes the isolated Magisk sniffer service.

patches.name: Disable tracking and analytics
patches.description: Disables analytics, crash reporting, performance monitoring, surveys and advertising attribution while keeping push notifications and Remote Config. Stops CleverTap, Qualtrics, Adjust, Facebook App Events, VdoCipher telemetry, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance, and Huawei AppGallery Connect.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs PackageManager signing certificate queries with the original Play Store certificate via Morphe's signature extension. Requires an unmodified stock APK.

patches.name: Bypass certificate checks
patches.description: Bypasses certificate pinning so intercepted TLS connections are accepted.

patches.name: Disable analytics and crash reporting
patches.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting while keeping push notifications.

patches.name: Disable root detection
patches.description: Disables the rooted-device check so the app runs on rooted devices.
